name: mandarake-surugaya-mcp
display_name: Mandarake & Suruga-ya MCP — Japanese Collectibles Price Comparison
description: Search Mandarake auctions, Suruga-ya collectibles, and Rakuten Ichiba via one MCP server. Compare prices across Japan's top hobby/collectibles shops in a single tool call.
long_description:
# Mandarake & Suruga-ya MCP Server

An MCP server that gives AI agents real-time access to Mandarake auction and Suruga-ya price data for Japanese collectibles.

## Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `search_mandarake_auction` | Search Mandarake auction listings by keyword |
| `search_surugaya` | Search Suruga-ya product prices by keyword |
| `search_rakuten` | Search Rakuten Ichiba products via official API |
| `compare_prices` | Cross-reference prices across Suruga-ya, Mandarake, and Rakuten |
| `get_actor_info` | List available tools and usage info |

## Pricing
$0.001 per tool call (Apify PPE).

## Requirements
Python >=3.10, uv. Set `APIFY_TOKEN` environment variable.

## Repository
https://github.com/atushi1841/mandarake-surugaya-mcp

## Apify Store
https://apify.com/fruitful_quintessence/mandarake-surugaya-mcp
